Mess menu for this week, same every week.
Monday: breakfast is poori bhaji and tea, lunch is dal chawal, dinner is aloo matar with roti.
Tuesday: breakfast is upma with coffee, lunch is rajma chawal, dinner is egg curry with rice.
Wednesday: breakfast is masala dosa, lunch is kadhi chawal, dinner is paneer do pyaza with roti.
Thursday: breakfast is idli sambar, lunch is chole rice, dinner is mix veg with roti.
